review_candidates.description: Bare-Metal Platform Engineer Audienzz AG · Engineering Location: Preferably Zurich. Remote work from elsewhere in Europe is possible for the right candidate; regular presence in Zurich is required. Employment: Permanent, full-time Seniority: Senior / Staff About Audienzz Audienzz is a Swiss digital advertising company developing and operating technology for publishers, advertisers and media partners. Audienzz is part of the NZZ group and operates independently, with its own technology decisions. Our engineering organisation runs a highly automated infrastructure platform based on Linux, Kubernetes, Ceph and Bazel. The platform runs more than 200 stateful and stateless services on self-managed bare-metal infrastructure. We operate the underlying infrastructure ourselves and are looking for an experienced Platform Engineer to strengthen our platform team. Your role As a Bare-Metal Platform Engineer, you will take end-to-end responsibility for the infrastructure and build platform on which our applications and data systems run, working closely with the engineers who built and operate it today. The role spans Linux, Kubernetes, Ceph, networking, automation, CI/CD and our Bazel-based build system. It is a hands-on engineering position for someone who enjoys understanding complex systems from the operating system and network layer through to build, deployment and production operations. Audienzz has around 80 people on the business side and an engineering team of around 40, with a small core of employees in Zurich and long-term external engineers across several European locations. Working language in engineering is English. Your responsibilities Operate and further develop our Kubernetes infrastructure, including node lifecycle, upgrades, capacity planning and production troubleshooting Provision and manage our bare-metal Linux infrastructure using Ansible and automation Operate and evolve our self-managed Ceph storage platform Own and maintain our Bazel-based build system for more than 200 services, including custom Starlark tooling, remote caching and remote execution Develop and maintain our Helm-based deployment tooling and GitLab CI/CD infrastructure Operate and improve networking, load balancing, DNS, TLS and ingress infrastructure Ensure the reliability of stateful and stateless workloads through observability, backup and recovery, performance analysis and incident troubleshooting Improve platform architecture, security, documentation and operational processes together with the wider engineering team What we expect Several years of hands-on experience operating self-managed Kubernetes in production (kubespray, kubeadm or comparable) Practical production experience with Ceph, including RBD, CephFS and/or object storage Strong Linux system administration and troubleshooting skills Experience running stateful workloads in Kubernetes Strong knowledge of configuration management, preferably Ansible Experience with Helm and infrastructure-as-code or GitOps workflows Experience owning CI/CD and build infrastructure Solid networking knowledge, including routing, DNS, TLS and load balancing Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Prometheus and Grafana Experience with backup, restore and recovery of production systems A structured approach to reliability, automation and documentation Very good written and spoken English You do not need to have worked with every technology in our stack. Strong fundamentals and the ability to understand, operate and improve complex infrastructure are more important than matching every individual tool. Production experience with self-managed Kubernetes and Ceph is required for this role. Nice to have Helpful, but not required: experience with Bazel or another large-scale build system, Go or Java for tooling, writing Kubernetes operators, experience in adtech or another data-intensive domain, and German. Our technology stack Infrastructure: Linux, Ansible, Kubernetes, containerd, etcd, Calico Storage: Ceph, RBD, CephFS, object storage Networking: MetalLB, ingress-nginx, Envoy, Gateway API, HAProxy Delivery: Helm, helmfile, GitLab CI, Harbor, Renovate Build: Bazel, Starlark, remote caching and remote execution Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager, Mimir, Loki, Tempo Data: Kafka, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, Redis, Spark Practical details Location: Preferably Zurich. Remote work from elsewhere in Europe is possible for the right candidate; regular presence in Zurich is required. On-call: Production alerts are routed to a Slack channel and handled by the platform team. There is currently no formal on-call rota; defining a sustainable on-call model as the team grows is part of this role. What we offer A technically challenging role with substantial ownership of a sophisticated production infrastructure and build platform Direct influence on platform architecture and technology decisions, with short decision paths Close collaboration with experienced software and platform engineers Work across the full infrastructure stack, in an environment where infrastructure and deployments are managed through code An engineering culture focused on reliability, automation and continuous improvement Interested? Send us your CV together with a few sentences about the most challenging infrastructure environment or problem you have owned end to end, including where you have operated self-managed Kubernetes and Ceph, and at what scale. jobs@audienzz.com Subject: Bare-Metal Platform Engineer Audienzz AG welcomes applications from candidates with different backgrounds and experiences. That means keeping their systems up and secure across AWS, Azure, and GCP while automating the work that shouldn't require a human. Work from defined runbooks for most incidents and diagnostics. Your job is automating the repetitive parts, surfacing problems before they page, and making incident response faster. Collaborate with our infrastructure experts to evolve how we detect and resolve incidents, leveraging proprietary, next-generation AI and automation platforms. Provide constructive architectural governance, challenging anti-patterns and guiding clients toward secure, reliable, and maintainable cloud solutions. Help expand our managed services solutions reliably as we mature cloud, software, and database patterns. You’ll contribute to the core platforms and patterns Mantel offers repeatedly to customers. Shape how we use AI and automation to accelerate reliability work across our customer base. You’ll help articulate how our AI driven solutions solve specific client problems. Build relationships with key technologists on the customer side. You’re not just fixing their incidents, you’re helping them understand what’s possible and what we can do together. Contribute to our internal optimisation and productivity backlog. You identify where toil exists and drive improvements that benefit all our customers. CI/CD & Version Control: Experience designing and maintaining automated deployment pipelines using commercial Git workflows (e.g., GitHub, GitLab) to ensure reliable delivery. Workload Management: Hands-on expertise provisioning and managing core compute workloads, particularly within Windows Server. Scripting & Orchestration: Fluency with scripting and orchestration technologies to build resilient, performant platform architectures. Client Engagement: A proactive client mindset - you’ll leave no stone unturned, identify platform bottlenecks early, and propose practical, high-impact solutions that align with the clients needs. Identity & Endpoint: A foundational understanding of modern cloud identity and endpoint tools like Microsoft Entra ID and Intune. Teamwork & Mindset: A customer first attitude, delivering service with a smile and the ability to work in both small and large teams. Cloud Architecture (Azure Focus): Deep expertise managing production workloads in Azure (AZ-305 and AZ-400 preferred). Practical exposure to AWS or GCP is a strong advantage, with full support provided for multi-cloud cross-skilling. AI & Emerging Tech: A functional understanding of modern AI advancements, with the curiosity and capability to leverage AI-driven tooling to enhance operational efficiency and reliability. Additional Experience: Experience with Azure Virtual Desktop, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Exchange, or on-premises infrastructure will be highly regarded, though not necessary. We value diverse skill-sets, and don’t necessarily require that you have all of the above. If you feel you cover roughly 70 – 80 % of the experiences/skills listed we still encourage you to apply or get in touch. What you can expect from us: You’ll get all the tools you need to hit the ground running including a new phone, laptop & swag. We believe in unique experiences for all. Our My Deal program allows you to tailor your yearly plan, with the support of your Leader, to decide on what’s most important to you. That might be extra professional development, extra annual leave, time to work on your side hustle, or something else completely different! One size does not fit all. A true investment in your AI-first career. We are a fully AI-enabled consultancy and provide you with the tools to lead. This includes access to the Mantel AI Gateway, our secure, centralised platform with multiple AI models, plus a dedicated monthly budget and a safe environment to experiment and innovate. You’ll be genuinely supported by an organisation that cares about not only you but your family as well, Mantel offers Flexible Personal Leave options for those unplanned moments in life. We support a flexible hybrid approach to working which is guided by our principles; we trust each other to “make good choices” about the best workplace locations for the requirements of the project, role and client. This can change based on our client needs. We know you won’t have one job for life. At Mantel, we believe in supporting our team to take their career in a direction that aligns with their passions. We have internal opportunities across Cloud, Data, Digital, Delivery & Security. Our elite partnerships are a direct result of our deep platform mastery. For you, this means you'll be working alongside teams with the highest levels of technical expertise and tackling the most complex, high-profile projects on the market. Check out our partner awards and recognitions here . Mantel is a certified Family Inclusive Workplace, which means we are committed to improving your wellbeing at work through leading practices on flexible work, parental leave, family care and family wellbeing We value a diverse workplace and strongly encourage people from all backgrounds and minority groups to apply. Click ‘Apply’ to be considered for this role and our Talent team will be in touch.
